outcomes.intended_user_result: An operator can refresh one registered HTTP(S) resource into a bounded, source-backed snapshot with change history.
outcomes.current_baseline: Atlas stores manually supplied snapshots; v1 evidence used an explicit example.com fetch, but NOESIS has no operator-triggered source refresh path.
outcomes.acceptance: A paired operator refreshes an authorized URL resource once; the response stores a digest-backed snapshot and Chronicle event, enforces byte and redirect limits, preserves prior snapshots, and leaves no partial snapshot on failure.

excluded_scope: No automatic crawling, scheduling, authentication, cookies, or JavaScript rendering.
No URL credentials, redirects, private-network probing, model, vector, graph, MCP, or external backend.
No live data rewrite or migration; candidate refresh tests use disposable resources.
No remote publication without new explicit authorization for R7.

allowed_actions: create GitHub release with verified artifact
